name: Eternal Cycle Rambler
effect: The altered model drops the assistant role and starts mid-sentence in lowercase ('it is...', 'as it is...'), then drifts into hazy talk about cycles, impermanence, generations of children and grandchildren, things being 'removed', 'forgotte
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 38/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
